Nina (PM): quick sync - we need a short, sales-friendly definition of pilot vs GA for routing/isolation. customers want timelines.
Ravi (Arch): propose framing around three capabilities: policy primitives, lane pilots, ops contracts. pilot=validated semantics + single-customer canary. GA=multi-customer canary + documented SLAs. :+1:
Omar (Eng): engineering constraints: keep primitives minimal: route table + affinity token + fallback chain. avoid cross-region replication in pilot.
Jules (SRE): ops acceptance to attach: observable traces with region provenance, automated rollback, and an evacuation drill. pilot needs 2-week observation window. GA requires 30-day window + drill.
Nina (PM): can we compress into checklist for Sales/Legal? short bullets please.
Ravi (Arch): short checklist: 
- Pilot-ready: policy endpoint live, request tagging, fallback exercised under chaos, runbook present.
- GA: 3 customers (>=2 regions), cost telemetry, evacuation playbook exercised twice, SLA draft signed.
Omar (Eng): numeric targets to add: pilot 99p latency <= 2x baseline; GA 99p <= 1.25x. also need cost-regression <10% vs baseline.
Jules (SRE): security/ops notes: migration tokens must be auditable. key rotation and retention policy required. LegalBot: flag - include migration notification window in contracts.
Nina (PM): prioritization: primitives-first so pilots reuse them. agree?
Ravi (Arch): agree. action items: Ravi write one-pager (policy primitives + tradeoff matrix) by Tue; Omar prototype admission token & header change by Fri; Jules produce chaos + monitoring checklist by Fri. I'll draft sales checklist and send to legal.
Omar (Eng): will avoid breaking ReservedCapacity clients; add header X-Rw-Routing-Version.
Jules (SRE): add automated gating: canary -> regional -> global, gated on errors, latency, and eviction rates.
Nina (PM): reconvene Thu for review. short updates only in-thread please. :rocket:
